subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity SLO runway & GPU handoff plan
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@novapath.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@novapath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity SLO runway & GPU handoff plan

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. High level recap + asks so we have a single place for the pilot runway and the handoff to our infra team: 

Summary of Novapath goals
- Primary SLO: 95th percentile latency <= 450ms for single-turn streaming replies (avg response length ~120 tokens).
- Peak concurrent active users: 240 sessions (concurrency measured as active request streams).
- Target sustained throughput for peak window: 2.8M tokens / hour (~777 tokens/sec sustained).
- Streaming behavior: clients send prompt in one chunk; model streams incremental tokens; we need end-to-end token-first-byte latency <= 300ms for p50 and <= 450ms for p95.

Prelim dedicated sizing note (what we discussed)
- Reserved throughput: 1 x reserved slab with 8k token context per request, ~12k requests/hour typical.
- GPU shortlist for pilot: H100 (lower latency, better throughput for fp16/4bit), A100 (widely available, stable), and L4 (cost-effective for smaller models / quantized variants).

Attached: performance matrix export (novapath_perf-matrix.xlsx) with the call's baseline numbers and the mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan_v1.pdf). Please review and confirm the p95 target and the expected peak window (local timezone / business hours).

Next steps (action owners):
- Novapath: confirm expected peak timezone for ramp and provide a 24h sample traffic CSV (Samir) — due Wed 21 Jun.
- Redwood infra: run targeted pilot tests against H100 and A100 with your sample (Ben) — staging run by Mon 20 Jun.
- Redwood product: validate streaming chunk size and recommend batching strategy (Aditya) — recommendation by Tue 21 Jun.
- Commercial: lock the pilot reserved slab and provisional pricing once pilot validates throughput (Kim) — coordinate with Priya for contract path.

If any of the SLO numbers above need to be loosened/tightened please flag in a quick reply. Otherwise we'll kick the infra pilot next week.

Thanks —
Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: novapath_perf-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samir Desai <samir@novapath.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@novapath.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Jun 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated capacity SLO runway & GPU handoff plan

Thanks Kim — this is helpful. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed p95 450ms is the goal; p50 target 220ms. Critical user flows are short-chat (40–80 tokens) and diagnostic summarization (200–300 tokens).
- Peak timezone: US Eastern, 09:00–11:00 local for business users; expect ramp from 08:45–11:15.
- We'll generate the 24h sample traffic CSV and drop into your Drive by Tue 21 Jun (Samir).

One more ask: can Redwood validate both end-to-end response time (including network egress to our app) and model-only token generation latency? We want both numbers documented in the matrix so our infra team can decide if network routing needs regional placement.

Also worth noting: we currently run a small on-prem inference for sensitive workflows — if H100 shows a big improvement we may consider a Private deployment later. For the pilot though, dedicated-hosted is preferred.

Appreciate the thorough plan.
Samir
Chief Product Officer, Novapath
[signature]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Desai <samir@novapath.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated capacity SLO runway & GPU handoff plan

Kim / Aditya — quick tech note after initial staging runs against Novapath sample (I used the seed prompts shared in Drive):

- Test setup: 2x model variants (open-llm-large fp16, quant-4bit), sequences limited to 2k context for throughput runs; simulated 250 concurrent streams.
- H100 (fp16) results (single-request streaming, emulated network): p50 token-first-byte = 95ms, p95 = 340ms, sustained tokens/sec (per GPU) ~ 2,200 (with efficient batching).
- A100 (fp16) results: p50 = 140ms, p95 = 420ms, sustained tokens/sec ~ 1,600.
- L4 (int8 / quantized) quick check: p50 = 220ms, p95 = 560ms, tokens/sec ~ 900 — good for cost-sensitive low-SLA workloads but misses your p95 target.

Implications: H100 gives a ~20–25% headroom against your p95 450ms target at our current batching; A100 is borderline at p95 for heavier requests (200–300 token summaries) — may need heavier batching or reserved extra slab to meet p95. L4 will likely require model distillation/quantization tuning or offloading to more GPUs to reach targets.

Actionable asks for bench refinement:
1) Samir: confirm distribution of request sizes (short vs medium vs long) in the sample so we can weight the mixed workload correctly.
2) Aditya: run a streaming chunk-size sweep (64 / 128 / 256 tokens) and measure token-first-byte latency — send results to Drive.
3) Kim / Commercial: If Novapath wants A100 to be the pilot baseline, we'll prepare an overflow policy (auto-fallback to a smaller slab + queued requests) and an ops runbook. If H100 is required for the SLA, we should flag pricing delta and lead time.

Attaching the quick CSV of test runs to the Drive folder for transparency.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: perf_runs_summary.csv (csv)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@novapath.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@novapath.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated capacity SLO runway & GPU handoff plan

Thanks Ben — great initial numbers and super helpful context. Samir / Priya — next steps and proposed timeline now that we have bench data: 

Proposed pilot path
- Week 1 (Mon 20 Jun – Fri 24 Jun): H100 vs A100 head-to-head with your full 24h sample, log both network-included and model-only latencies (Ben).
- Week 2 (Mon 27 Jun – Wed 29 Jun): Streaming chunk-size sweep + batching experiments (Aditya) to optimize token-first-byte vs throughput trade-off.
- End of week 2 (Thu 30 Jun): Plan readout and go/no-go recommendation for reserved slab (Kim).

Commercial / Ops notes
- If results show H100 is needed to comfortably meet p95 450ms, we will provide a pricing delta for H100 reserved slab + estimated lead time.
- Fallback policy: A100 primary + overflow to additional A100 slab during short spikes (ops book drafted by Tessa).

Please confirm: 1) Novapath agrees to the two-week pilot timeline; 2) Samir will deliver the 24h CSV by Tue 21 Jun. Once confirmed I'll docket the pilot in our capacity calendar and share a temporary access link to the staging cluster for your engineers.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
